name: arrow-player
description: Free, open-source, privacy-first music player — desktop dependency manifest.
$no-qt: Qt is NOT a vcpkg dependency and must never be added here. It comes from official prebuilt binaries via aqtinstall at the version pinned in qt-version.txt. Spec section 6.2 states the consequence directly: desktop/vcpkg.json MUST NOT list Qt. See docs/adr/0005-qt-acquisition.md.
$baseline: REQ-SEC-013 forbids floating versions. The baseline above is vcpkg tag 2026.07.29; it is the pin for every port here except ffmpeg, which needs an explicit override because the baseline default is newer than the 7.1.x the register and section 6.3 both name.

tempo.description: Pitch-preserving tempo/speed and BPM detection (REQ-AUD-090..093, section 6.6).

fingerprint.description: Content-based duplicate detection (REQ-LIB-070, REQ-LIB-071). Local and offline; the AcoustID network lookup is a separate opt-in (section 9.9).

rtaudio.description: Last-resort Linux fallback sink (REQ-AUD-073, [v1.x]). Off by default, matching the ARROW_ENABLE_RTAUDIO CMake option; it is never bit-perfect and must never be a platform default.

tests.description: GoogleTest for the unit, integration and conformance suites (section 21). Test-only, never shipped.
